alternatives.facts: Free linprog HiGHS solves continuous linear objectives with inequality/equality/box constraints and returns primal residuals and inequality/equality/bound marginals.
alternatives.comparison: Natural complete mathematical comparator is direct LP min/max under the SAME forward model, error budget and conservative certificate checks. Do not deny ordinary users dual values or count library reuse as discovered science.

alternatives.facts: SIRT supports minimum/maximum constraints, projection masks and several2D geometries; FBP/CGLS/3D alternatives are also available.
alternatives.comparison: Point reconstructions are natural baselines, but point output is not automatically a guaranteed feature interval.

alternatives.facts: Free iterative CT toolbox includes algebraic, Krylov and total-variation methods; public code supports incomplete-data experiments.
alternatives.comparison: Give TV/iterative reconstruction its natural configuration; no arbitrary human staff cost. It does not automatically provide this exact worst-case admissible-support contract.

alternatives.facts: CUQIpy-CIL interfaces with Core Imaging Library for Bayesian CT inverse problems and compares deterministic solutions.
alternatives.comparison: Free uncertainty quantification already exists. Prior/posterior credible intervals differ from worst-case set-membership support; neither claim may be substituted silently.

alternatives.facts: Describes upper/lower bounds on mean intrinsic error in a specified region using phase-composition information; keywords include linear inverse problem and linear program.
alternatives.comparison: Generic ROI-error bounds are established prior art. Exact equivalence with our instrument is unadjudicated without the full underlying derivation.

alternatives.facts: Monte Carlo Reconstruction propagates sampled instrument-geometry uncertainty into voxel gray-value distributions and dimensional measurements.
alternatives.comparison: Geometry/calibration error cannot disappear because the candidate verifies floating-point algebra. A physical claim needs calibrated error coverage.

alternatives.facts: Commercial limited-angle acquisition/reconstruction exists; example partial rotation270degrees improves magnification for constrained objects. Vendor claims high image quality and automated center-of-rotation handling.
alternatives.comparison: Vendor product claims are not independent qualification or our exact sparse-view support guarantee. Partial-angle imaging is not an unavailable capability in general; license/quote price unknown.

alternatives.facts: Commercial reconstruction supports multiple geometries, artifact corrections and data-quality analysis per ASTM E1441/E1695. Related coordinate-measurement software includes locally adaptive surface determination.
alternatives.comparison: A complete industry route includes calibration, corrections, quality checks and automated reporting. Public price and equivalence with set-support intervals are unknown.
